videos.script: A tag can move, and lesson 7 pinned production by digest so it could not. A digest says which bytes. It does not say who made them. {{who}} This lesson makes your own key pair and signs the bulletin image with it. The signature sits in the registry, right beside the image. {{sign}} Then you verify it, and you watch the two ways a check fails. Nobody signed, or somebody else did. {{fail}} You read what Docker wrote about how the image was built. {{provenance}} Then the cluster's side. Flux gets the public key through the repository, and refuses a chart nobody signed, even after review and merge said yes. {{refuse}} Last, signing without a key to lose, signing commits, and checks at the cluster's door that see every pod. {{door}}
